why_this_register_exists: The three frozen screenshots are raster images with no text layer. Their expected values were read by eye from named pixel crops, not parsed. A matching SHA-256 proves the BYTES are the ones Bariah sent; it proves nothing about whether the transcription of those bytes is character-perfect. Those are two different claims and this register keeps them apart.

confidence_scale.HIGH: characters are unambiguous at native resolution; no plausible alternative reading
confidence_scale.MEDIUM: wording unambiguous, but at least one character or mark is at the raster limit
confidence_scale.LOW: an alternative reading would change meaning; must be confirmed before use
